note: Shawnee National Forest campground on the ridge above a quiet northwest arm of Kinkaid Lake near Ava, in three small loops about half a mile from the day-use area and boat launch. Large sites with hitching posts and highline poles; horses camp in the same loops. --Claude

FS page: 'Johnson Creek Campground featuring large campsites, hitching posts and highline poles, it is one of the few Forest Service campgrounds that allows equestrians and their stock.' Guide (2016): 'Johnson Creek campground is one of two campgrounds in the forest that caters to equestrians. It features large sites with tables, fire rings, hitching posts and highline poles.' and regulation '5. Equestrian camping allowed in campground.' The map shows one campground (Loops 1-3) with a separate 'Equestrian Trailer Parking' day lot only. Same pattern as Camp Cadiz, dropped in p3-476.

FACILITIES: potable_water true -> false. The current FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' and the 2026 fees sheet leaves Johnson Creek's Water column blank; the 2016 guide's 'water available at pump house near campground entrance' is older.
SITES: max_rig_ft 40 (note-derived 'group sites take RVs to ~40 ft') is not on any FS page; the pages say only 'large campsites'. Left as stored; reviewer may clear.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The guide map puts the three loops on the ridge west of the day-use area, ~0.4 mile from the lake, and the FS rules say 'Camp at least 150 feet from the lakeshore.'
PHONE: none -> 618-833-8576 (Mississippi Bluffs Ranger District, the office the FS page and guide give). WEBSITE current, kept.
PIN (optional, under 250 m): stored 37.8335,-89.519 is the end of Loop 1; the loops' centre (~37.8341,-89.5207) is ~165 m WNW and matches the FS page point 37.83444,-89.52056.
